caption: The drawing depicts two objects on a plain, off-white background. At the top center of the composition, there is a brown cup with a single handle on the left side, decorated around its upper rim with a dark Greek key or meander pattern in black. Below and centered directly underneath the cup is a circular saucer shown from a top-down perspective, colored primarily in dark brown and featuring a decorative, raised design of leaves and flowers radiating outward from a plain central circle. The artist's name, "HARRY MAIN WADDELL," is inscribed in small, uppercase letters in the lower right corner of the page. There are no other objects or details within the image, and the objects are spaced with significant white space between and around them.
title: Small Cup and Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
